venues.long: A sparkling Italian cocktail bar with Bellinis, spritzes and Prosecco. Drinks are included with Plus and Premier.

venues.long: A traditional nautical lounge for single-malt Scotch, small-batch bourbon and classic pre-dinner cocktails.

features: Adults 18+ for most treatments; facials from 16
venues.title: Lotus Spa
venues.short: Massages, facials, acupuncture and medi-spa treatments, run with OneSpaWorld.
venues.long: The ship’s wellness sanctuary: bamboo and hot-stone massages, ELEMIS Pro-Collagen facials, seaweed wraps, acupuncture and physician-administered medi-spa services. On embarkation day the spa opens with guided tours.

venues.title: Lotus Salon and Barber
venues.short: Hair, nails, barber shaves and teeth whitening.
venues.long: Hair styling, keratin treatments, barber shaves, manicures, pedicures and teeth whitening, next to the Lotus Spa. Formal-night updos and blowouts book up early.

venues.title: The Enclave Thermal Suite
venues.short: A paid-access hydrotherapy and thermal sanctuary with a Himalayan Salt Room.
venues.long: A warm hydrotherapy pool with cascading rain showers and air jets, heated ceramic loungers, a Turkish hammam, an aromatic herbal steam room, a dry Finnish sauna and, on Sun Princess, a Himalayan Salt Room and sensory experience showers. A thermal pass is about $149 to $199 a week, or a session can be booked here.

venues.title: Sanctuary Club
venues.short: The adults-only sun deck for Sanctuary Collection guests, with an infinity pool and private bar.
venues.long: Reserved for Sanctuary Collection suite and stateroom guests: an infinity pool, a private bar and live DJ chill sessions on the top deck. Weather permitting.

venues.title: Princess Arena
venues.short: The transformable theatre-in-the-round for the headline production shows.
venues.long: Movable seating banks and a rotating central stage, with surround sound, LED backdrops and aerial rigging. It hosts Viva La Música, Vallora: A Pirate Quest, Stage Struck and Fiera!, as well as guest comedians and vocalists.
accessibility: Wheelchair spaces on both sides of the middle block; ask an usher

venues.title: The Dome
venues.short: A glass dome that is a pool deck by day and an acrobatic theatre by night.
venues.long: A glass-roofed dome with a waterfall pool and tiered lounge seating. At night the pool is covered to make a stage for the Cirque Éloize productions Blue, Come Fly Away and ArtBeat, aerialists and late-night DJ parties.

venues.title: The Piazza
venues.short: The three-deck glass atrium for live music, street performers and pop-up parties.
venues.long: A glass sphere looking out to sea, around a central stage and an LED screen. From morning until midnight there are string quartets, acoustic duos, classical pianists, aerial pop-up acts, dance classes and the Captain’s Champagne Waterfall.
accessibility: Each level has a lift to the others

venues.title: Princess Live!
venues.short: A TV-studio lounge for game shows, trivia and late-night comedy.
venues.long: Styled like a television soundstage, with camera rigs and banquette seating. By day it has trivia, cooking demonstrations and Wake Show tapings; at night it is a comedy club and game-show arena.

venues.title: O’Malley’s live music
venues.short: Nightly live folk and acoustic rock in the Irish pub.
venues.long: Resident soloists and duos play Celtic classics, sing-alongs and pub rock every evening, with Irish whiskey tastings. Food and drink are in the Dining Explorer.

venues.title: Wheelhouse live music
venues.short: Piano, jazz combos and ballroom dancing in the nautical lounge.
venues.long: A refined lounge of wood panelling and brass ship models. Afternoon board games give way to resident pianists, jazz combos and slow dancing in the evening. Drinks are in the Dining Explorer.

venues.title: SeaView and Wake View Terraces
venues.short: The outdoor decks for sailaway parties, deck bands and Movies Under the Stars.
venues.long: The forward SeaView Terrace has the giant LED screen and the main pool stage; the aft Wake View Terrace has an infinity pool and a sunset bar. Weather permitting.

venues.title: Spellbound by Magic Castle
venues.short: A speakeasy parlour of close-up magic and theatrical cocktails, by ticket.
venues.long: Made with Hollywood’s Magic Castle, behind an unmarked door: secret rooms, smoking cocktails in the Music Room and a 30-seat velvet theatre for illusionists. Seatings are ticketed and small.

venues.title: Princess Casino
venues.short: The largest casino in the fleet, closed in port.
venues.long: Over 9,000 square feet with more than 200 video slots, progressive jackpots and 13 live tables, including blackjack, craps, roulette, three-card poker, Ultimate Texas Hold’em and baccarat. A separate smoke-free annex has its own bar. Slot machines, live table games and electronic roulette, paid with your Medallion through ticket-in, ticket-out. It is run in international waters, so it is closed in port and opens 30 to 45 minutes after the ship sails.

venues.short: The two-deck Broadway-style theatre for production shows and headliners.

accessibility: Wheelchair spaces at the back and sides; ask an usher

venues.short: The only dedicated jazz theatre at sea, with a live trio each night.
venues.long: A mid-century Harlem jazz club of exposed brick and neon. By day there are salsa lessons and acoustic sessions; at night a resident trio plays themed sets, with craft cocktails.

venues.title: Vista Lounge
venues.short: The aft cabaret lounge for comedians, party bands, bingo and theme parties.

venues.title: Princess Live! and Café
venues.short: A TV-studio venue for trivia, culinary shows, game shows and late-night comedy.
venues.long: A studio audience with audience keypads and cameras feeding the cabin TVs, and its own espresso and cocktail bar. Daily trivia, talent auditions and adult comedy at night.

venues.title: The Piazza
venues.short: The three-deck marble atrium with continuous live music and gala parties.
venues.long: A European town square at sea. String ensembles, ballroom demonstrations, fruit-carving demonstrations and the Captain’s Champagne Waterfall, from morning to night.
accessibility: Each level has a lift to the others

venues.title: Santa Fe Dining Room
venues.short: Anytime dining on the lower level: reserve a table or walk in.
venues.long: Anytime dining on the lower level: reserve a table or walk in. Traditional three-course dinner with a southwestern night. On the menu: Chile-rubbed salmon, slow-cooked pork carnitas, a vegetarian enchilada, and a different dessert every night.

venues.title: Vivaldi Dining Room
venues.short: Anytime dining on the upper level. Same menu as Santa Fe.
venues.long: Anytime dining on the upper level. Same menu as Santa Fe. Traditional three-course dinner. On the menu: Seared sea bass, roast chicken with herbs, a vegetable wellington, and a different dessert every night.

venues.title: The Eatery
venues.short: The main buffet, with international and made-to-order stations.
venues.long: The main buffet, with international and made-to-order stations.

venues.title: The Lido (Lido Eats)
venues.short: Grill, tacos, greens and pizza by the pool.
venues.long: Grill, tacos, greens and pizza by the pool.

venues.title: International Café
venues.short: Open all day and night. Food is included; specialty coffee is extra.
venues.long: Open all day and night. Food is included; specialty coffee is extra.

venues.title: Alfredo’s Pizzeria
venues.short: Neapolitan pizza, walk-in only.
venues.long: Neapolitan pizza, walk-in only. Neapolitan pizza. On the menu: Margherita, diavola and a pizza of the day, with a dessert to share.

venues.title: Crown Grill
venues.short: Steakhouse.
venues.long: Steakhouse. Steakhouse. On the menu: Aged filet, a shared seafood tower, creamed spinach and a warm chocolate soufflé.

venues.title: Sabatini’s
venues.short: Italian trattoria.
venues.long: Italian trattoria. Italian trattoria. On the menu: Hand-rolled pasta, veal Milanese, a tiramisu made at the table.

venues.title: Vines Wine Bar
venues.short: Wine by the glass, flights and small bites.
venues.long: An intimate wine lounge with more than 30 wines by the glass, sommelier flights and tapas with your wine.

venues.title: Wheelhouse Bar
venues.short: Single malts, bourbons and classic cocktails.
venues.long: A traditional nautical lounge for single-malt Scotch, small-batch bourbon and classic pre-dinner cocktails.

features: Adults 18+ for most treatments; facials from 16
venues.title: Lotus Spa
venues.short: Massages, facials, acupuncture and medi-spa treatments, run with OneSpaWorld.
venues.long: The ship’s wellness sanctuary: bamboo and hot-stone massages, ELEMIS Pro-Collagen facials, seaweed wraps, acupuncture and physician-administered medi-spa services. On embarkation day the spa opens with guided tours.

venues.title: Lotus Salon and Barber
venues.short: Hair, nails, barber shaves and teeth whitening.
venues.long: Hair styling, keratin treatments, barber shaves, manicures, pedicures and teeth whitening, next to the Lotus Spa. Formal-night updos and blowouts book up early.

venues.title: Thermal Suite
venues.short: A classic thermal suite with heated tile beds and aroma steam rooms.
venues.long: Sapphire Princess has no Enclave. Its Lotus Spa Thermal Suite on Deck 15 has heated tile beds and aroma steam rooms, and the locker rooms have complimentary dry saunas and steam rooms.

venues.title: The Sanctuary
venues.short: An adults-only (18+) open-air retreat with teak loungers and steward service.
venues.long: A tranquil adults-only retreat with thick-cushioned teak loungers, chilled face towels, misters and light healthy fare, with outdoor massage cabanas. Half a day is $20 and a full day $40. Weather permitting.

venues.title: Princess Theater
venues.short: The classic two-tier theatre for production revues, concerts and variety.
venues.long: Warm wood and plush seating. Evening revues (Bravo, Encore, Magic to Do or Born to Dance) with the Princess Singers, Dancers and showband, and afternoon lectures and classical recitals.
accessibility: Wheelchair spaces at the back and sides; ask an usher

venues.title: Club Fusion
venues.short: The aft lounge for Pop Star karaoke, line dancing, bingo and party bands.
venues.long: Dozens of synchronised screens, theatrical lighting and a wooden dance floor at the end of the Promenade Deck: Princess Pop Star, dance lessons, bingo and live bands.

venues.title: Explorers Lounge
venues.short: A midship lounge for trivia, auctions, comedy and cover bands.
venues.long: Safari, Egyptian and Silk Road decor with its own bar and stage. Morning trivia and port talks, then audience game shows, guest comedians and live rock and pop.

venues.title: Wheelhouse live music
venues.short: Ballroom, swing and blues bands in the clubby nautical lounge.
venues.long: Dark mahogany and a hardwood dance floor: quiet cards by day, then live ballroom, swing and classic blues in the evening. Drinks are in the Dining Explorer.

venues.title: Skywalkers Nightclub
venues.short: The glass lounge high over the stern: a quiet viewpoint by day and a nightclub after 10 pm.
venues.long: Reached by a glass-walled moving walkway, with 270-degree ocean views from 150 feet up. Quiet tiered seating by day, especially for scenic cruising; a resident DJ and a neon dance floor after 10 pm.

venues.title: The Piazza
venues.short: The three-deck atrium, the heart of the ship, for quartets, lessons and the Champagne Waterfall.
venues.long: Around the International Café and Vines Wine Bar: string quartets, ballroom lessons, street-style variety acts and the Captain’s Welcome Champagne Waterfall.
accessibility: Each level has a lift to the others

venues.title: Crooners
venues.short: The piano martini bar for Rat Pack requests.
venues.long: A piano bar beside the Piazza with Rat Pack classics and martini requests. Drinks are in the Dining Explorer.

venues.title: Neptune’s Reef Pool and Movies Under the Stars
venues.short: The main lido pool with a giant screen, bandstand and deck parties.
venues.long: Tiered sun decks and hot tubs around the main pool, for sailaway parties, live bands and games by day and an open-air cinema with blankets and popcorn at night. Weather permitting.

venues.title: Princess Casino
venues.short: Slots and table games, closed in port.
venues.long: A classic midship casino with 150 to 180 slots, live table pits and automated Texas Hold’em tables. Slot machines, live table games and electronic roulette, paid with your Medallion through ticket-in, ticket-out. It is run in international waters, so it is closed in port and opens 30 to 45 minutes after the ship sails.
